completion_rule: An operation becomes COMPLETE only when its CoreSpec law, program encoding, bounded verification, reference evaluation, VM, AOT, source producer, differential evidence, and deletion of every legacy semantic dependency from the canonical pipeline are complete in one vertical slice.

precut_route_policy.state_during_w7: each migrated product route is canonical-only and fail-closed; uncovered capabilities remain explicitly incomplete
precut_route_policy.cutover: each development route removes its legacy reachability atomically; terminal closure removes every remaining old product node together

core_spec_stage.note: Operation rows advance only by complete W7 vertical slices. Twelve scalar/control/sealed-call rows are COMPLETE_W7_WAVE1; aggregate construct/project/update and all three named record-variant operations are COMPLETE_W7_WAVE2; owner move/drop and local place load/store are COMPLETE_W7_WAVE3_SLICE2; explicit copy and the monotone ownership-domain proof are COMPLETE_W7_WAVE3_SLICE3; sealed invoke plus typed error and panic publication are complete; existential pack/test/project, witness direct/invoke, and callable pack/indirect direct/invoke have complete executor slices but remain IN_PROGRESS until source integration and old-owner deletion; provider.call has a complete Program and executor foundation but remains IN_PROGRESS until manifest, analyzer, Xglobal, and Xi publish its exact identity; trap and profile query remain frozen for their owning waves.

program_format_stage.note: W2 owns canonical bytes and bounded structural decode. W3 owns typed admission; executor coverage remains frozen for W5-W7.

semantic_admission_stage.note: All 46 registered operations have bounded verification and independent reference evaluation. Existential pack/test/project use exact TypeId and conformance facts with dominating-test projection admission; witness direct/invoke use exact interface slots and conformance dispatch; callable pack/indirect direct/invoke use exact SignatureId authority and closed FunctionId targets with optional typed capture aggregates; provider-backed operations use exact dense provider requirement and operation references; source publication remains fail closed until its owning slice activates it.

vm_stage.note: All 46 registered operations execute in the independent typed VM and match the reference evaluator. Provider operations use only ABI-matched lease-pinned typed adapters; output is compared byte-for-byte across the reference evaluator and both VM decode policies. Private existential/callable carriers, witness/callable dispatch tables and fixed rows are disposable runtime views, not a second public bytecode or distribution format.

aot_stage.native_identity: ExecutionId + BackendId + ToolchainId + OptimizationPolicyId + native bytes
aot_stage.note: All 46 registered operations lower through an independently verified BackendIR into portable C11 without a live XrInstance or lease. Embedded AOT exposes ABI-matched typed provider callbacks; hosted standalone output binds directly to a binary stdout sink, and freestanding standalone output without an embedder fails closed. Existential and callable carriers remain backend-private; witness and indirect calls become closed typed direct-call switches, and the pure native fixtures link no VM, compiler, program loader, or AOT toolchain.
